category.name: Shapes
category.preferred_workflow: Use DocumentBuilder.InsertShape or InsertImage for all shape insertions, create any image or OLE source files in a temporary folder before loading, configure only the properties required for the task (size, wrap, positioning, fill, stroke), and finally save the document and verify the output file and shape type.

strict_api_bans: Never call members that are not defined in Aspose.Words 26.11.0, such as Shape.StrokeDashStyle, Shape.GetActualBounds, or ShapeType.SnipCornerRectangle.
Do not reference System.Drawing types without adding the System.Drawing.Common package.
canonical_patterns: Insert shapes with DocumentBuilder.InsertShape or InsertImage and then adjust properties like Width, Height, WrapType, RelativeHorizontalPosition, and RelativeVerticalPosition.
When a shape must appear inside a table cell, set IsLayoutInCell = true after insertion.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate only the existence of the saved document and that the inserted shape's ShapeType matches the expected value.
Avoid inspecting unrelated node collections or document internals that are not part of the requested behavior.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The compiler reports missing members or enumerations such as Shape.StrokeDashStyle or ShapeType.SnipCornerRectangle.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Code references APIs that were never implemented in the selected Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the invented members with documented alternatives like Shape.StrokeColor, Shape.StrokeWeight, or use ShapeType.Rectangle for custom rectangles.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words API reference for the exact version before using any member.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1069 indicating that Bitmap or Graphics cannot be found.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The project does not reference the System.Drawing.Common assembly required for image creation.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add a reference to System.Drawing.Common via NuGet and use the provided types only for temporary image generation.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Include System.Drawing.Common in the project file whenever the sample creates bitmap files.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS1501 errors show that InsertOleObject is called with an unsupported number or type of arguments.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code supplies parameters that do not match any overload defined in Aspose.Words.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Call InsertOleObject with the signature (string fileName, bool isLinked, bool asIcon, string iconFileName) and omit unsupported arguments.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Verify overload signatures in the API documentation before passing arguments.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0200 errors indicate attempts to assign to ShapeBase.ShapeType or Shape.AspectRatioLocked.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The properties are read-only; shape type cannot be changed after creation, and aspect ratio is controlled via Shape.AspectRatioLocked (available) rather than a non-existent setter.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create the shape with the desired ShapeType initially and set AspectRatioLocked = true after insertion.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Set shape characteristics only through mutable properties; do not attempt to reassign read-only members.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime ArgumentException states that a node of this type cannot be inserted at the current location.
common_failure_patterns.cause: A shape or GroupShape is appended to a node that does not accept child nodes of that type (e.g., inserting a GroupShape directly into the document body).
common_failure_patterns.fix: Insert shapes using DocumentBuilder methods or append them to a Paragraph node, which is a valid container for Shape nodes.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always use DocumentBuilder or Paragraph.AppendChild to add Shape objects.

narrative.overview: The Shapes category demonstrates how to create, configure, and manipulate drawing objects in Word documents using Aspose.Words 26.11.0. Verified examples cover image insertion, textbox creation, OLE embedding, table-cell layout, custom rectangles, bounds retrieval, vertical anchoring, SmartArt replacement, horizontal rules, and MathML rendering.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with concise, reliable patterns for inserting and formatting shapes in Aspose.Words documents while avoiding unsupported APIs and ensuring that all required resources are created locally.
validation_priorities: Confirm that the output file exists on disk.
Assert that the created shape's ShapeType equals the intended type (e.g., Image, TextBox, Rectangle).
maintenance_notes: Periodically review the Aspose.Words release notes to update the list of supported shape properties and enumerations.
